components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full pill shape for major CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 18px 42px; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: oklch(60% 0.18 30); color: oklch(100% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(60% 0.18 30); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: transparent; color: oklch(60% 0.18 30); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px oklch(60% 0.18 30 / 0.3); }

components.name: Specialty Card
components.html:
Artisan Breads

Hand-shaped and baked in small batches.
components.css: .ds-specialty-card { background: oklch(100% 0 0); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.04); transition: all 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); position: relative; border: 1.5px solid transparent; } .ds-specialty-card:hover { border-color: oklch(60% 0.18 30); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-specialty-body { padding: 32px; font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-specialty-body h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 10px; color: oklch(25% 0.06 30); font-family: 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; } .ds-specialty-body p { font-size: 0.92rem; color: oklch(50% 0.06 30); line-height: 1.7; }

narrative.overview: Warm, elegant, and deeply crafted. This design system leans into the physical, tactile nature of artisan baking—focusing on patience, craft, and premium ingredients. It explicitly avoids the artificial constraints of SaaS scaffolding, flat generic neutrals, and over-animated "web 3" tropes.
keyCharacteristics: Muted, deeply saturated brand tones anchored in baked terracotta
Soft layering with diffuse ambient shadows
Refined, editorial typography pairing a classic serif with a warm geometric sans

rules.name: The Restrained Strategy Rule
rules.body: The brand relies heavily on the "Committed" color strategy where the saturated terracotta sets the identity but never overwhelms the content. Neutrals are tinted toward the brand hue, never generic gray.

rules.name: The Artisanal Type Rule
rules.body: Never use training-data defaults (Inter, Roboto) paired with generic serifs (Playfair). Treat typography as editorial craft.

rules.name: The Tactile Restraint Rule
rules.body: Elements must never employ harsh, narrow drop-shadows. Shadows should feel ambient and diffuse, casting a soft, colored glow where appropriate.

dos: Do cap body text line length at 65ch.
Do tint neutral backgrounds slightly toward the primary brand hue to retain warmth.
Do use Forum strictly for display typography without faux bolding.
donts: Don't use standard emojis as design elements; use proper SVGs or rely on elegant typography.
Don't use generic AI scaffolding like marquee animations, numbered eyebrows, or custom cursors.
Don't mix CSS transitions that cause layout thrashing (e.g., width); use transform instead.
Don't use the SaaS "hero-metric" template with large gradient stats grids.
